testCase.name: [dev] S30 Second device after a patient delete: the open chart stops showing the patient, cannot write it back, and leaves no draft

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S30 「删病人之后的第二台设备：开着的病历不再显示这个病人，不能把它写回去，也不留草稿」 Second device after a patient delete: the open chart stops showing the patient, cannot write it back, and leaves no draft

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept.（UAT TC-24；TFA-92579 AC 2；TFA-94699 AC 4）
  • T3 No state a delete leads to shows a blank screen, a crash or a raw error: a deleted patient's chart link, the emptied patient list, a patient deleted while its note is generating, and a second device …（TFA-94745 AC 2；UAT Empty & Failure States）

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Same account signed in twice (A and B, each with its own email code). B has the Hospital patient's chart open with unsaved pre-round text typed.

When A deletes the patient from its card (OK). B, without reloading, watches the chart, then presses Save Note. Then the runner reads B's IndexedDB.

Then Within the sync window B stops showing the patient's name and diagnosis and shows a clear message or the list, not a blank screen. B's Save Note ends in an explicit error and creates nothing: roundingPatients get(id) stays null and no new chart appears. Draft keys for the deleted chart in B's 'roundcompanion-session-drafts' store are recorded for Q6(c).

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92579 AC 2 (all data immediately) and TFA-94745 AC 2 (no blank screen); related to UAT TC-25 'A deletion on one device disappears from the other' (not claimed here). B's checkpoint must not contain the name or the diagnosis; a person checks that the landing is not blank (oracleRules 3). Server read after B's Save Note. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 MULTI · 多端 / 多账号；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S30 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：MULTI · 多端 / 多账号 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
